items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the band that he was in when he came to our high school to play... It was Robert Barnes, Donald Byrd, Roland Hana, Claude Black on French Horn and trombone.

ctx.x: When I met Claude black, he came to our high school to play. And the band that he was in when he came to our high school to play, they had the top band in the eastside or whatever, in Detroit. It was Robert Barnes, Donald Byrd, Roland Hana, Claude Black on French Horn and trombone.
See, I know him as a piano player.
